text:
alex: quick async standup — prepping lightweight-routing launch next week. What I did: finalized spec (https://redwood.docs/rl-light-routing), toggled feature in staging, updated rollout plan. Blockers: infra quota for 4x GPUs not confirmed, telemetry schema change needs a small CR, and one failing e2e in stability tests. Today: ping infra, get CR merged, coordinate canary suite.

sara: thanks alex — pinged infra in #eng-infra, they asked for usage estimate and traffic profile. can you drop numbers? :pray:

alex: numbers added to the rollout doc — peak qps ~1800, p50 token latency target 120ms, estimate 3.5GPU steady, 4 for headroom. PR for telemetry: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4821 — small schema bump in `events.proto`.

binh: on the PR — will review by EOD. quick heads-up: I left a comment about backward compat on old consumers. if we need a migration window we should call it out in the release notes.

lucas: if infra quota slips, we can start with 2 GPUs + aggressive autoscale. I can prep a fallback routing policy to reduce model width during canary. Example policy snippet: ```yaml
fallback_policy:
  max_replicas: 2
  quantize: true
  batch_timeout_ms: 10
```

mira: QA note — I'll run the canary smoke and perf harness once the canary is scheduled. need a sample payload and the expected success criteria. suggest: 50 reqs/s for 10m, 95th latency < 300ms, and pass the rerank smoke tests. sample payload: `{"query":"summarize: user session"}`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted: canary job scheduled for 2026-03-18T11:30Z on `staging/light-routing` :rocket:

sara: action items recap: @sara to follow up infra, @binh finish PR review, @lucas prepare fallback policy, @mira prepare canary suite and test payloads, @alex update rollout doc and release notes. please +1 when done. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — I'll also add a quick rollback playbook (tiny runbook with `kubectl scale` commands and feature toggle steps). ping here when reviews are in and I'll cut the canary.
